commentary_title: VLCC market softens as demand stays quiet
commentary_summary: The VLCC tonne-miles index declined in week 50. Fleet utilisation currently stands at 91.3%. | Global laden speeds rose during the week in contrast to a slight decline in global ballast speeds. The proportion of eastbound laden voyages fell in week 50 while westbound laden voyages increased. | Both the Arabian Gulf and West Africa VLCC markets remained relatively quiet with limited chartering enquiries. Market direction in the near term will depend on whether demand improves in the coming weeks.
